items.title: Bob Cranshaw interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Bob has performed with Lee Morgan, Wes Montgomery, Horace Silver, Ella Fitzgerald and Joe Williams

ctx.x: Bassist Bob Cranshaw could create an extraordinary resume of his career. He was born in Evanston, Illinois in 1932 and started on the piano and drums, later taking up bass in high school. His first professional work came in Chicago with the MJT+3 with Walter Perkins. His move to New York in 1960 enabled him to join forces with jazz giant Sonny Rollins and this longstanding relationship still flourishes today. Bob has performed with Lee Morgan, Wes Montgomery, Horace Silver, Ella Fitzgerald and Joe Williams, and…
Bob was interviewed by Michael Woods on October 18, 1995 in New York City.
